concept: A friendly trailhead rest stop built around daily walks, small journeys, and the satisfaction of another step forward.
floor: One broad continuous expanse of smooth compacted trail earth across the full top face in warm muted ochre, with gentle large-scale shading but no grass, separate path, footprints, pebbles, cracks, grains, or repeated texture.
main_structure: One compact open-front hiking lodge at the rear with a broad muted-blue roof, warm timber walls, and one glowing doorway.
rear_props: one large blank trail-map board and one simple gear rack holding a single oversized rolled blanket
side_props: one chunky rest bench and one broad water station along the upper-left edge
two simple waypoint posts and two large pine forms along the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth sky-blue trail parapet made from broad rounded masses
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple orange footprint emblems

materials: a few broad muted ochre blocks

lighting: clear soft trail daylight with one broad doorway glow and two restrained amber lantern glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open compacted trail earth
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, separate path, stepping-stone trail, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable signs, text, watermark, external shadow
grass, flowers, footprints in the floor, tiny leaves, pine needles, pebbles, cracks, grains, specks, or dense hiking clutter
